description: Read content, owner source, owner settings or statistics for a publication. Site content returns its manifest or named path. File content returns a download reference. KV without key lists keys. Continue long content with the returned offset.

kind.description: Publication kind returned by publish or list

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

offset.description: Next character offset from a previous read

password.description: Reader password when content is protected

path.description: Relative site file path. Omit for the owner manifest

tz.description: Stats only. IANA time zone, default UTC

view.description: Default content. HTML source, settings and stats are owner reads

name: read_publication
title: Read a BrewPage publication
